build_catapult_task: build a phyre task template that creates a catapult scene with a ball and container goal
create_task_with_define_task_template: create a phyre task using define_task_template decorator with seed range and search parameters
add_box_with_virtual_tools: add a static box object to the phyre scene using vt.add_box with position and flip options
add_container_goal: add a container goal to the phyre scene using vt.add_container with vertex coordinates
update_task_relationship: update the phyre task goal by setting body1, body2, and TOUCHING spatial relationship
